draft_en.subject: For the industrial switch line on iotech-italia.net - next to the Wlink routers
draft_en.body:
Hello Luca,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 16 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the industrial Ethernet switch line you represent next to the Wlink routers, at representative/distributor price, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed with ring redundancy, Marvell-based - model STI-288DGGPM - $137.5 USD; the non-PoE version - STI-280DGGM - $121; compact 4 x PoE+ + 1 x SFP, unmanaged - STI-144GP - $34.1. English datasheets; an Italian one-page summary I can prepare from your wording.

One question: do your customers buy the industrial switch with the router as a kit, or separately per cabinet?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
